lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.title: Butterfly Pattern Play
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.summary: Build a balanced butterfly, repeat a few mirrored marks, then invent extra wing patterns of your own.
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.step.body_: Draw the butterfly body in the center and curve two antennae out from the top.
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.help.body_: Use the middle of the page like an invisible line that keeps both sides balanced.
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.complete.b: The center is ready. Now the wings have a clear place to connect.
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.step.upper: Build the two broad upper wings, one on each side of the body.
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.help.upper: Compare the outer tips. Try to keep them at a similar height.
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.step.lower: Add the smaller lower wings and let them tuck under the upper pair.
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.help.lower: Keep the lower wings a little smaller so the silhouette stays clear.
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.complete.l: The full butterfly shape is complete.
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.step.patte: Add a matching curved mark near the top and a small loop lower down on both wings.
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.help.patte: Place one mark, then look across the body and echo it on the other wing.
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.complete.p: You have a mirrored starter pattern. Add extra dots, stripes or shapes in your own way.
lesson.butterfly_pattern_play.coloring.f: Color the butterfly freely. You can repeat colors symmetrically or make each wing surprising.
